requirements.quote:
When an endpoint receives a Limit value greater than 10, it MUST reject
the message with a limit_error response.
requirements.condition: an endpoint receives a Limit value greater than 10
requirements.required_behavior: reject the message with a limit_error response
requirements.why_checkable: The parser's upper-bound and error-mapping branches can be inspected and tested.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST accept Limit values from 0 through 10 when all other
message fields are valid.
requirements.condition: all other message fields are valid
requirements.why_checkable: The valid inclusive range can be checked in the parser and at both boundaries.
